timeBasis: Local elapsed minutes from the start of the same calendar day
assumptions: All staff counted toward the simplified four-person floor requirement can perform that work throughout the planned absence.
Each deployment is a mutually exclusive complete option, with location access recorded as confirmed for the stated activity and window.
Deployment cost includes all additional labor, transport, materials and commissions attributable to the plan; already committed spending is excluded.
Contribution is venue-retained USD per genuinely additional guest after the offer and relevant variable costs, with no duplicate cost deduction.
Baseline tables assume zero discount loss on guests who would have attended anyway; that loss must be added separately if present.
The customer journey is a planned thirty-minute allowance, conditional on a person accepting the offer; it predicts neither acceptance nor attendance.
No further push is a zero-additional-spending baseline, not a prediction about the evening or a claim that it meets a revenue objective.
No demand distribution, expected customer count, causal marketing effect or preferred profit-maximizing plan is supplied.
bounds: An editorial worked-case fixture verified by ordinary arithmetic and declared-condition checks. It is not a Decision Lab app package, workflow export, customer trial or native SDK evaluation. Role-specific interval coverage, demand estimation, source authentication and venue-specific permissions require further modeling and operating review.
